newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-First Boston starts hospital stocks.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-First Boston starts hospital stocks.

text.p: -- CS First Boston said analyst Howard Capek initiated five hospital stocks.
-- started Health Management Associates Inc, Quorum Health Group Inc and Tenet HealthCare as strong buy.
-- initiated Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp and Universal Health Services Inc as buy.

-- Capek, in a research note, estimated earnings per share for Hospital Management at $0.96 per share for 1997, and $1.16 for 1998 versus $0.76 in 1996, and set 12-month price target of $36. Company runs rural/non-urban hospitals, including 22 acute-care, four psychiatric, and two surgery centers.
-- on Quorum, estimated earnings of $1.66 for 1997, and $1.99 for 1998 versus $1.38 for 1996. Set 12-month target of $40.
-- for Tenet, estimated earnings of $1.45 for 1997, and $1.76 for 1998 versus $1.24 in 1996, and set 12-month target of $38.
-- for Universal, estimated earnings of $1.98 for 1997, and $2.28 for 1998 versus $1.66 in 1996, and set 12-month target of $44.
-- for Columbia, estimated earnings of $2.55 for 1997, and $2.93 for 1998 versus $2.22 for 1996. Set 12-month target of $45.
-- Columbia was unchanged at 37-3/8, Health Management rose 1/2 to 28-3/4, Tenet gained 3/8 to 26-7/8, Quorum was up 5/8 to 34-5/8, and Universal added 1/8 to 38-3/8.
